title: Mystic Aurora Sorceress
description: A woman with long dark hair in a glowing green and gold robe kneels on a rocky outcrop, weaving luminous magical patterns with her hands. She is surrounded by ethereal white wolves, flying white birds, blooming cherry blossoms, ancient scrolls with symbols, and lotus flowers under a dramatic night sky filled with aurora borealis and swirling yellow energy.
prompt: A mystical woman with long dark hair wearing a flowing green and gold robe kneels on rocky cliffs at night, weaving intricate glowing magical sigils and energy threads with her hands. Ethereal white wolves and birds appear around her, cherry blossom branches bloom with pink flowers, ancient scrolls with runes lie nearby, lotus flowers float in the water below. Dramatic night sky with vibrant green and purple aurora borealis, swirling yellow lightning-like energy, stars, and cosmic clouds, in a detailed fantasy digital painting style.
